lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In the far north of Norway stood a village called Husk. Every autumn, the whole village came together to bring in the harvest before the snow.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Alice was nine years old. High above the village was a cave, and in that cave lived dragons. Earth, water, stone, crystal, light. And last of all, the king of them all: fire.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Alice had never seen a dragon. She wanted to, more than anything.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every year, some of the harvest went to the forest spirits. The most important of these were the pandas.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: While most pandas were reserved and serene, Po was shy. Too shy even to join the festivities.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Which is kind of why Alice liked him best.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The whole village stopped. Then it ran. Everyone ran for home, and Alice ran the other way.

lines.speaker: ALICE
lines.text: [breathless, excited] Po! Can you take me in the sky to see the dragons?

lines.speaker: PO
lines.text: [alarmed] Are you crazy? You're going to get eaten by them.

lines.speaker: ALICE
lines.text: [sly] If you take me, I'll give you extra juicy bamboo.

lines.speaker: PO
lines.text: [reluctant] I'll take you. But only if you keep this sword with you. Just in case.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So Alice climbed on. And they flew.
